entry.title: Maneckji Tower of Silence, Yazd (east)

buildingCutout.basis: Keep the original6m standard Mapzen hill, native roads/water and every independent building including the western tower and lower precinct. Replace only this eastern native circle. Court/pit floor is bounded to the mapped circle and seated above occupied coarse-ground maxima; pit remains truly recessed without cutting native ground. A bounded battered raw-stone contact surface within the mapped footprint supports the court above coarse grade; its profile is a visual approximation of the rocky tower seat, not newly surveyed hill terrain. Buried feet and narrow supported stairs meet coarse grade. This visualization contact estimate does not claim a surveyed hill profile, excavation or foundation engineering; no whole-hill mesh, broad slab, ground/water cutout or valley flattening.
